_comment: Bristling fur over a slender cat tail (C1, Natsuho's phase 2: 'her tail fur puffs up'): a chain laid over the bones of the tail an earlier part built (`reuse`, so it takes that tail's points and size), each segment a fat box with two boxes rolled about it (fine_), a tapered tip of fur tufts. Worn as a phase part (`"phase": 2`), its boxes nest in p2_tail_* children of the tail's own bones, so the puffed tail follows every key and every spring of the tail it covers; the slender tail inside it is hidden by the fur. Lint and the sheets wear it over tails/cat_long (`requires`).
